note: _absque synagogis facient vos_ – they will separate you from the synagogues, literally: they will make you away from the synagogues.

_docebit vos_ [in] _omnem veritatem_ – he will teach you all truth. Weber/Gryson has the _in_, the Clementina omits it. One suspects that if there is to be _in_, the verb must be _ducet_ (future tense of _ducere_, to lead) – he will lead you to all truth. The NVg has: _deducet vos in omnem veritatem_.
